description:
Secret Agent Clank is a 2008 PS2 action-platformer spin-off following
Ratchet, Clank, Qwark, and the Gadgetbots on an undercover mission
across the galaxy.
NOTE: this world is an early scaffold — planets/missions/weapons/gadgets
are all placeholder content and every game-memory address is unconfirmed
(see core/address_maps/ps2.py).

## Installation & Setup

- Requires [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases/latest). Make sure you are up-to-date.
- Download the `.apworld` file below and double-click it to install. Restart Archipelago after installation.
- Use **Options Creator** or **Generate Template Options** in the Archipelago Launcher to create player option YAML files.
- Place your edited player option YAML files in the `Players` folder. Use **Browse Files...** in the Launcher to open the Archipelago directory.
- Make sure you have all required `.apworld` files, your player YAMLs, and any desired `host.yaml` settings ready before generating. (`server_password` is recommended for admin login.)
- Click **Generate** to create a multiworld `.zip` in the `output` folder.
- Upload the generated `.zip` to https://archipelago.gg/uploads or self-host it. Self-hosting requires port forwarding.
- For detailed setup instructions and game-specific documentation, see [game-specific documentation](https://github.com/Panguu/Archipelago-RaCSM/tree/SAC-Main/worlds/secret_agent_clank/docs).
- If you encounter errors, run `ArchipelagoLauncherDebug.exe` or launch Archipelago from a terminal and check the `logs` folder.
- Need help? Join the Archipelago Discord: https://discord.gg/8Z65BR2
